description: Source code for custom Rocket UI elements and interactions in the Unvanquished game, including functions for manipulating RML content, attributes, properties, and element registration.

classes.name: RocketConsoleTextElement
classes.description: Class managing console text lines for Rocket UI.

methods.name: Rocket_QuakeToRML
methods.description: Converts Quake-style text to RML format, parsing colors and emoticons based on flags.

methods.name: Rocket_GetElementTag
methods.description: Retrieves the tag name of the currently active UI element.

methods.name: Rocket_RegisterElement
methods.description: Registers a new custom Rocket element with a specified tag.

methods.name: Rocket_SetInnerRML
methods.description: Sets the inner RML content of the active element, escaping HTML characters and parsing flags.

methods.name: Rocket_SetInnerRMLRaw
methods.description: Sets raw RML markup as inner content of the active element.

methods.name: Rocket_GetAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value from an element specified by name and id.

methods.name: Rocket_SetAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute on the active element.

methods.name: Rocket_GetElementAbsoluteOffset
methods.description: Gets the absolute position of the active element.

methods.name: Rocket_GetElementDimensions
methods.description: Gets the dimensions of the active element.

methods.name: Rocket_GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the active element, supporting string, float, int, and color types.

methods.name: Rocket_SetClass
methods.description: Sets or unsets a CSS class on the active element.

methods.name: Rocket_SetPropertyById
methods.description: Sets a property on an element identified by id or on the active element.

methods.name: Rocket_AddConsoleText
methods.description: Adds a line of text to the console text element, with special handling for newlines.

methods.name: Rocket_RegisterProperty
methods.description: Registers a new style property with optional parsing.

methods.name: Rocket_SetDataSelectIndex
methods.description: Sets the selected index of a data select control.
